design.outer: 5-fold GroupKFold on Bemis-Murcko scaffold, molecule level
design.inner: GroupShuffleSplit by scaffold, 25% of outer-train molecules reserved for calibration
design.label: record active = pActivity >= 6.0; molecule active = max over records (historical rule, unchanged)

variants.A_structure_only: Morgan2048 + 12 RDKit descriptors, one row per molecule
variants.B_assay_deployment: assay-conditioned model scored as max over top-5 training assay contexts (matches clinical-library screening)
variants.B_assay_legacy_true_assay: assay-conditioned model scored with the test molecule's true assay IDs (historical evaluation, not achievable at deployment)

data_audit.endpoint: pChEMBL Value (IL-1beta release assays, Assay Type B, relation '=')
data_audit.label_rule: record active = pActivity >= 6.0; molecule active = max over records (historical rule, unchanged)
data_audit.standardisation: RDKit MolFromSmiles -> SanitizeMol -> MolToSmiles; duplicates collapsed per canonical SMILES
data_audit.features: Morgan radius-2 2048 bits + 12 RDKit descriptors (+ top-25 assay one-hot for the assay-conditioned model)

historical_reference.comparability_note: The historical AUROC/AUPRC are means over folds of a CV in which each test record carried its true assay ChEMBL ID, so they are comparable only with the B_assay_legacy_true_assay variant. The historical Brier score was computed from the production model whose isotonic calibrator was fitted on records the base model had already been trained on, so it has no honest counterpart here.
